copyFrom.requires: commission plus copyMode=restart or complete objectContinuity

conceptDesign.confirmation: confirm-concept with explicit conceptIds and user source
conceptDesign.selection: recommendation-only; select with user source atomically revises confirmed concept or reuses historical image
conceptDesign.history: immutable records; copiedFromConceptId preserves source-chain feedback

storyboardHandoff.request: cueIds with aligned exact conceptIds, excludedCueIds, stable requestId, expectedRevision and actual user source
storyboardHandoff.transaction: confirm pending selected concepts and append selected/excluded object snapshots atomically; all-confirmed still persists scope
storyboardHandoff.status: conceptDesign.storyboardHandoff latest record with advisory current/problems
storyboardHandoff.authority: storyboard scope handoff only; no new production gate or Motion/Demo/delivery authorization
storyboardHandoff.execution: saved by browser; Agent continues from conversation; no automatic wake or rendering

sceneReview.targets: cueId plus storyboardId or artifactId and user source
sceneReview.identity: storyboard reviewInputKey or verified video artifact with sceneInputKey for the cue interval

creativeInputs.allCandidates: register after generation/import; recommend:false for non-recommended images
creativeInputs.sourceReferences: original paths are provenance; actual inputs have readable version-owned copies
creativeInputs.historicalMaintenance: explicit scoped authorization; no automatic migration or cleanup

demoReview.navigation: versionId, tab=preview, artifactId; explicit missing targets never fall back
demoReview.sceneMapping: new movie reviewCues freezes rendered cue identity and rational placement; old unmapped videos permit time-only feedback
demoReview.rework: review-submit with artifactId, feedbackIds (or exact roundId), inline authorize-demo decision with new taskId, explicit cueIds and user source; inherits presentation, exclusions and time boundary from reviewed movie commission
demoReview.execution: register only; Agent modifies and previews with the same taskId
demoReview.entry: CLI preview/cache/resume adds live reviewEntry; shared production APIs do not manage services

statusViews.authority: read-only projection of existing status and feedback resolver; no new execution permission

cueUpdates.merge: omitted fields preserved; dictionaries merged recursively; arrays replaced
cueUpdates.excludes: patch.cues in same request; deletion, rename, object/adapter rebinding and arbitrary JSON Patch

conceptBatch.request: items with cueId, imageSource, origin, idea, motion, explicit recommend
conceptBatch.recommendation: at most one true per object per batch; all false preserves existing recommendation
conceptBatch.authority: registration only; no adoption or confirmation
conceptBatch.transaction: existing update publication, rollback and request deduplication

creativePlanning.storage: optional version-manifest creativePlanning: plans, rounds, attempts
creativePlanning.editableAuthority: cues only; planning records are snapshots and history
creativePlanning.discussion: understand full script and available rough cut; propose and negotiate; present complete production list and wait for an explicit answer to additions before image generation
creativePlanning.closure: planId plus actual user source; affected content or scope changes need discussion, unrelated writes and technical renaming do not reset agreement
creativePlanning.status: summary gives current objects, rounds and historyCount; full status and cue detail retain relevant history

limits.scope: stable creative object per autonomous exploration round

creativePlanning.counting: actual failures and retries count; one multi-image call counts once per object; user-imported images do not count; idempotent writes do not duplicate calls
creativePlanning.pending: occupies one slot; reconcile actual tool evidence before retry or a new round; never reset as uncalled without evidence
creativePlanning.candidateLink: concept register/register-batch planningAttemptId; archive all outputs; stale results do not replace the current recommendation
creativePlanning.continuation: explicit user source opens a new round with previousRoundId; retain history; separate from concept.round
creativePlanning.authority: creative recovery records only; no image-tool execution or interception, no production qualification and no media/review/delivery identity input

reviewEntry.entry: CLI concept update and completed preview/cache/resume results; service lookup/start only after the core transaction
reviewEntry.submission: every visual result submitted to the user uses its exact formal Review URL; internal screening needs no per-call handoff; direct media or temporary HTML does not replace Review
reviewEntry.targets: ordered complete targets list; first target remains at top level for compatibility

navigation.concept: tab=overview plus conceptId, including non-recommended candidates
navigation.storyboard: tab=storyboard plus storyboardId and cueId; optional frameId
navigation.video: tab=preview plus artifactId for local-preview, cue-preview or full-preview
navigation.batch: targets query parameter is a JSON-encoded array of exact target descriptors

reviewEntry.historicalStoryboard: status.storyboard.snapshots projects frozen scene text, frame mapping and image identities
reviewEntry.missingTarget: explicit error; no fallback to latest result or another version
reviewEntry.internalFlag: --no-review-entry suppresses service startup but retains targets, query and reopen
reviewEntry.failure: preserve successful write or production receipt and exact reopen targets; retry the original request without duplicate generation, registration or rendering
reviewEntry.reading: refresh, service restart and new artifacts preserve the selection and unsaved feedback anchors; user chooses a newer result
reviewEntry.localVideo: reuse the formal player with original type/time/feedback; no full-Demo-only rework or delivery actions
reviewEntry.authority: navigation only; no production or delivery authorization; URLs are not persisted in manifest or jobs
